svg.text: Friction-ellipse utilisation against distance, all six deployed policies. The corner is where both variants work hardest and where they agree; the straight afterwards is where they part company.
share of each tire's grip in use
variant H — RL Mz + allocator — 3 seeds, lap average 36%
variant E — end-to-end — 3 seeds, lap average 70%
Lap-average utilisation is 36% for H and 70% for E, a gap of 3.1x the seed-to-seed standard deviation. CLAUDE.md rule 5 asks for more than 2x before
a difference counts as a finding, so this one does — while the lap times and peak cornering forces, which sit at 0.5x and 1.3x, are reported as no
[MEASURED] per-step max over the four wheels of hypot(Fx/Fx_peak, Fy/Fy_peak), deployed policy, 3 seeds per variant · RUNG 2 (rule 15)
One line per seed. Traces end where that policy's lap ends.
